description: This is a test class for the MenuService component within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing menu item retrieval based on user roles (admin and supervisor). It extends a kernel test case, sets up mock services and users, and verifies the structure of menu items returned by the service.

classes.name: MenuServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for MenuService, testing menu generation for different user roles within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initializes test data by populating fixture YAML files before any tests run.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment before each test, including instantiating MenuService and disabling I18N.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Restores I18N setting after each test.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForAdmin
methods.description: Verifies menu items for an admin user, checking both cached retrieval and structure correctness.

methods.name: testGetMenuItemsForSupervisor
methods.description: Verifies menu items for a supervisor user, validating correct menu options and structure.
